title: 100 new things
changes: 3 new kinds of staff: Citizen Scientists, Collaboration Spokespersons and Directors-General.
5 new research topics, each with its own info page: neutrino oscillations, quark–gluon plasma, antihydrogen, tetraquarks and pentaquarks.
32 new upgrades, including the first ones that raise your funding, upgrades for anomalies and time away, and two new colliders.
60 new achievements for the new staff and research, reputation, data per click, anomalies, time played and bigger totals.
The new staff and research start where the original ones run out, so there is always something to work towards.
Fixed missing icons on the LHCb upgrade and the data processed achievements.

title: Anomalies
changes: Rare anomalies now appear on the detector every few minutes. Click one before it fades for a data burst, a funding windfall or a 30 second data boost.
Three new achievements for catching anomalies.
Research can now be done ×1, ×10 or as many levels as you can afford at once.
This update log, so you can see what has changed.

title: Quality of life
changes: Your lab keeps earning while the game is closed, for up to 24 hours.
Data and funding per second are shown under the counters.
The Statistics window shows time played, rates, staff, research levels and achievements.
Hire staff ×1, ×10 or as many as you can afford at once.
Export your save as a code and import it again, for backups or to move to another device.

title: The Particle Simulation
changes: The game is now called The Particle Simulation.
